meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: 装上后，当你给一个已有的说话人/访谈/播客视频时，Claude 会为它配上与语音同步的图形卡片（动态标题、底部字幕条、数据引用、侧栏、画中画），并渲染成 MP4 视频，原始画面保持不变。
howto.when: 当你说“graphic overlays”“on-screen graphics”“package/dress up my video”等词，或要求给视频加图形包装时触发。不是纯字幕需求；若不明确会转到 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这个访谈视频加上动态标题和底部字幕条。
say.note: Claude 为视频生成图形卡片并渲染 MP4。

say.text: 给我的播客视频做图形包装，加几个数据引用卡片。
say.note: 按转录内容自动设计卡片。

say.text: 用竖屏 9:16 给这段讲话视频加画中画和侧栏。

howto.what_en: When given an existing talking-head/interview/podcast video, Claude layers timed graphic cards (kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP) synced to speech, then renders an MP4. The original clip plays untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", or "package/dress up my video". Not for plain subtitles; if unclear, it routes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add kinetic titles and lower-thirds to this interview video.
say_en.note: Claude generates graphic cards and renders MP4.

say_en.text: Package my podcast video with data callout cards.
say_en.note: Cards are designed from the transcript.

say_en.text: Make a 9:16 portrait version with PiP and side panels.
